subject: in-process qc testing
statement: Verify equipment calibration certificates are current; complete environmental monitoring checks; review and sign Batch Manufacturing Record; perform in-process qc testing per approved batch record; record all parameters in BMR in real time; collect in-process samples at defined intervals and submit to QC; report any deviation immediately to supervisor and document per SOP QA-DEV-9179-60; upon completion, clean and sanitize equipment per SOP QA-CLN-8517-28
supporting_quote: 5.1 Verify all equipment calibration certificates are current and within acceptable limits. 5.2 Complete environmental monitoring checks and confirm area is within specification. 5.3 Review and sign Batch Manufacturing Record (BMR) prior to commencing operations. 5.4 Perform in-process qc testing according to the approved batch record instructions. 5.5 Record all process parameters, observations, and measurements in the BMR in real time. 5.6 Collect in-process samples at defined intervals and submit to QC for testing. 5.7 Any deviation from this procedure must be immediately reported to the supervisor and documented per SOP QA-DEV-9179-60. 5.8 Upon completion, clean and sanitize all equipment and workspace per SOP QA-CLN-8517-28.
trigger_conditions: Prior to commencing in-process qc testing operations
steps: Verify all equipment calibration certificates are current and within acceptable limits
Complete environmental monitoring checks and confirm area is within specification
Review and sign Batch Manufacturing Record (BMR) prior to commencing operations
Perform in-process qc testing according to the approved batch record instructions
Record all process parameters, observations, and measurements in the BMR in real time
Collect in-process samples at defined intervals and submit to QC for testing
Report any deviation immediately to supervisor and document per SOP QA-DEV-9179-60
Upon completion, clean and sanitize all equipment and workspace per SOP QA-CLN-8517-28
